dataset.notes: Studio-quality, single-signer, plain-background images. No diversity in skin tone, lighting, or camera angle.

accuracy.top3_note: Suspiciously perfect — likely inflated by similar classes
accuracy.wild_test_note: No wild test set exists yet. This is the most important missing metric.

per_class.notes: All broken classes are visually-similar confusion pairs: 2↔3, 6↔7, M↔N, O↔0. Currently patched by geometric overrides in the frontend.

known_issues: No signer-disjoint validation split — val accuracy is inflated
No wild test set (unseen signers, lighting, phones)
Single-frame model — cannot learn dynamic/motion signs
Two-hand support was faked via mirroring (now deleted)
Word-level signs are geometric rules, not ML predictions
